FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Savor Bistro, we operate a full-service dining establishment focusing on providing a family-friendly atmosphere and a diverse menu that features locally sourced ingredients. Our restaurant is designed to accommodate up to 150 guests, optimizing our service efficiency while ensuring a comfortable dining experience. We offer a variety of food options, including vegetarian and gluten-free dishes, served alongside a selection of beverages to complement our meals, adhering strictly to our guidelines of not exceeding 30% of total revenue from beverage sales. Our spacious premises, which are under 7,500 square feet, enhance guest accessibility and safety, with carefully planned layout and décor that create a welcoming ambiance.

To maintain high standards of food safety and customer service, our staff undergoes regular training regarding food handling protocols and responsible service. Our kitchen is equipped with fire suppression systems in compliance with local fire codes, ensuring the safety of both our patrons and staff. Savor Bistro prides itself on fostering a community-oriented environment, hosting local events, and supporting nearby businesses while maintaining a focus on year-round operations with no seasonal closures exceeding 30 days.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2021, a commercial kitchen fire occurred due to a malfunction in the cooking equipment, resulting in damages totaling $5,000. The fire suppression system activated successfully, preventing further spread. The claim was filed and settled promptly with no further status updates as repairs were completed by May 1, 2021.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Wall-mounted safe, Class II, fire-resistant, 1-hour fire rating, UL-listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secured perimeter fencing and monitored surveillance cameras around the premises.
